outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented rendering (molecular/structural reconstruction) of pre-conoidal rings and actin filament, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering of the basal end of a sporozoite showing actin bundles and IMC; it is a structural/schematic visualization, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with filaments highlighted, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel D is a schematic/3D rendering of a lateral section showing actin populations, illustrative rather than a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged tomographic volume (micrograph-type image), not a plot with averaged statistical values.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament and connecting densities, not a plot requiring individual data points.
